newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mostly lower in choppy trading.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mostly lower in choppy trading.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mostly lower as a choppy trading pattern continued, traders said.
Little new feature was mentioned with the oncoming harvest of U.S. rice amid reports of good yields capping rallies, they said.
"Nearby supplies are tight but Asian markets are steady to weak," a trader said, referring to the offsetting bullish and bearish signals for rice futures.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 400 contracts, down from 428 Monday. Rice options volume was estimated at 50 contracts, up from 29 Monday.
Rice futures closed unchanged to nine cents per cwt lower, with September unchanged at $10.28.
